claim_ceiling: This manifest specifies a research protocol only. Protocol conformance does not establish a driving model, simulator competence, real-world transfer, roadworthiness, safety, certification or SAE Level 4/5 capability.

hypothesis.statement: At matched initial checkpoint, initial corpus, action space, simulator exposure, human intervention and compute budgets, decision-sensitive experience selection improves sample efficiency and/or held-out competence without worsening predeclared worst-family constraints, calibration, fallback integrity or deadline compliance.
hypothesis.falsification: A null result or an outcome favouring a simpler sampler is valid. Average score improvement with a predeclared guardrail regression is not a positive result.

sampling_arms.description: Uniform over eligible episodes and scenario families.
Frequency or inverse-frequency based scenario selection.
Predictive entropy or ensemble disagreement only.
Recent temporal or world-model prediction error.
Near action-ranking boundaries or small feasible-set margins.
Expected decision-sensitive information value before the relevant decision deadline.
Option fragility, recovery depth, residual decision time and counterexample evidence.
Fixed-rate instructor interventions; not an autonomous policy.

budget_profiles.purpose: Isolate learning value from matched experience exposure.
Measure practical learning efficiency under matched cost.

metrics.definition: New simulator transitions until a preregistered skill threshold is achieved on the frozen validation gate.
Instructor intervention minutes until the same frozen skill threshold.
Area under the frozen competence versus cumulative simulator-transition curve.
Area under the frozen competence versus cumulative instructor-time curve.
Task success per sealed map/scenario/actor/fault family.
Worst per-family rate of simulator-defined hard-constraint violations.
Proper probabilistic score for future ego/actor state and observation variables, selected according to the declared predictive distribution.
Empirical coverage of preregistered prediction sets at their declared nominal levels.
Post-decision evaluator-only utility gap between the best admissible candidate and the selected admissible candidate; hard-constraint violations are reported separately.
Fraction of requested information events that alter action admissibility, action ranking, recovery classification or uncertainty disposition.
Matched held-out outcome difference after the answer/correction versus a no-query continuation.
Independently qualified SAM recoverability depth under a named state, action and fault profile.
Fraction of evaluated decision points with an evidence-qualified fallback that meets the declared deadline and resource contract.
Time remaining before declared recovery alternatives become infeasible, under named simulator and actuator semantics.
p95 end-to-end policy computation latency under a declared measurement boundary.
Measured energy per simulator transition only when source-grade raw telemetry is available.
Observed/expected episode and branch reconciliation with failures, incomplete and censored records retained.
Exact agreement rate for receipt identities and declared replay outputs in a fresh process.

prospective_targets.caveat: 20% is an initial research target, not an achieved result, universal threshold, or safety guarantee.

external_benchmarks.caveat: Pin local simulator and scenario revisions; original public Leaderboard 2.1 submission service is closed.
Pin version and score semantics; report data, compute, teacher and privilege differences.
Preserve exact frame-drop, partial-observation, state-noise and latency protocols.
EPDMS includes precomputed follow-up scenes; not a reciprocal online driving simulator.
Visual and trajectory quality does not establish driving competence.
Confirm dataset license and task-specific protocol; no physical vehicle validation.
